findings.message: The case authenticates as warehouse_operator, but the requirement authorizes only sales_manager; the input does not define the warehouse_operator result, so replacing the success oracle would require inventing authorization behavior.
evidence: TC-AUTH-001.expected_outcome=HTTP 200 is returned with status APPROVED.
REQ-AUTH-001.text=Only sales_manager may approve an order through POST /api/v1/orders/{order_id}/approve; a successful approval returns HTTP 200 with status APPROVED.
